setRegDesc: Hongdou does not expose a citation-registration API, so citing notes cannot be registered like the Obsidian build. Workaround: push the note back to Hongdou so its body shows up as a Hongdou note.

welcomeLead: Hongdou manages the literature, SiYuan writes the paper. The plugin talks to Hongdou over local MCP — no extra plugin or pairing needed.
welcome1b: Keep Hongdou running; the plugin connects to 127.0.0.1:18500 by default. Use Test connection in settings if it fails.
welcome2b: Search the command palette for Citation style and choose GB/T 7714 or APA. Both in-text citations and the bibliography follow it.
welcome3b: Put the cursor where the citation belongs and press Shift+Ctrl+I. A citation appears and the bibliography grows at the end.
welcome4b: Press Shift+Ctrl+R after adding or removing items: numbering closes up and the bibliography follows. Right-click a citation to switch to narrative form or jump to its entry.
